description: Budgetku design tokens + Tailwind mapping + PWA foundation. Add finance/account-accent HSL CSS variables and a larger radius to app/globals.css (keeping all existing grayscale tokens), map them in tailwind.config.ts with new radii and a soft shadow, update app/layout.tsx metadata/viewport for Budgetku + Apple PWA + viewport-fit cover, add app/manifest.ts, and create a public/icons placeholder README. Foundational and independent of FEAT-002; FEAT-003 depends on the tokens and shell metadata added here.
steps: Edit app/globals.css: in :root add finance tokens --income: 152 45% 42%; --income-foreground: 0 0% 100%; --expense: 0 60% 55%; --expense-foreground: 0 0% 100%; and account-accent palette --accent-blue: 214 40% 56%; --accent-violet: 258 38% 60%; --accent-emerald: 160 36% 44%; --accent-amber: 38 55% 56%; --accent-rose: 346 46% 60%; --accent-slate: 215 20% 48%; with each paired *-foreground: 0 0% 100%. Raise --radius from 0.5rem to 0.9375rem.

Edit app/globals.css: in .dark override --income: 152 42% 52%; --expense: 0 58% 62%; --accent-blue: 214 42% 52%; --accent-violet: 258 38% 60%; --accent-emerald: 160 36% 46%; --accent-amber: 38 52% 56%; --accent-rose: 346 44% 60%; --accent-slate: 215 18% 56%; keep all *-foreground: 0 0% 100%. Do NOT remove or change any existing token (background/foreground/card/primary/chart/etc.).

Edit tailwind.config.ts: under theme.extend.colors add income: { DEFAULT: 'hsl(var(--income))', foreground: 'hsl(var(--income-foreground))' }, expense: { DEFAULT: 'hsl(var(--expense))', foreground: 'hsl(var(--expense-foreground))' }, and account: { blue: { DEFAULT: 'hsl(var(--accent-blue))', foreground: 'hsl(var(--accent-blue-foreground))' }, violet: {...}, emerald: {...}, amber: {...}, rose: {...}, slate: {...} } following the hsl(var(--token)) pattern already used. Keep every existing color mapping.

Edit tailwind.config.ts: under theme.extend.borderRadius add xl: 'calc(var(--radius) + 4px)' and '2xl': 'calc(var(--radius) + 8px)' (keep lg/md/sm). Add theme.extend.boxShadow with soft: '0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.03), 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04)'.

Edit app/layout.tsx: import type { Viewport } from 'next' (alongside Metadata). Change metadata.title to 'Budgetku' and description to a personal-finance line (e.g. 'Budgetku — a clean, minimal personal finance app.'). Add appleWebApp: { capable: true, statusBarStyle: 'default', title: 'Budgetku' } to the metadata object. Add `export const viewport: Viewport = { width: 'device-width', initialScale: 1, viewportFit: 'cover', themeColor: [{ media: '(prefers-color-scheme: light)', color: '#ffffff' }, { media: '(prefers-color-scheme: dark)', color: '#0a0a0a' }] };`. Keep metadataBase, the Geist font setup, and the ThemeProvider wrapper exactly as-is.

Create app/manifest.ts: `import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next'; export default function manifest(): MetadataRoute.Manifest { return { name: 'Budgetku', short_name: 'Budgetku', description: 'A clean, minimal personal finance app.', start_url: '/dashboard', display: 'standalone', background_color: '#ffffff', theme_color: '#0a0a0a', icons: [ { src: '/icons/icon-192.png', sizes: '192x192', type: 'image/png', purpose: 'any' }, { src: '/icons/icon-512.png', sizes: '512x512', type: 'image/png', purpose: 'any' }, { src: '/icons/icon-512-maskable.png', sizes: '512x512', type: 'image/png', purpose: 'maskable' } ] }; }`

Create public/icons/README.md: short note that these PNG icons must be dropped in and are referenced by app/manifest.ts (and the Apple touch icon by layout metadata): icon-192.png (192x192), icon-512.png (512x512), icon-512-maskable.png (512x512 with ~10% safe padding, maskable), apple-touch-icon.png (180x180). Do NOT generate any binary image files.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 with no TypeScript errors and the Route output lists /manifest.webmanifest.

app/globals.css still contains all original tokens (background, foreground, card, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring, chart-1..5) in both :root and .dark, plus the new income/expense/account tokens, with --radius: 0.9375rem.
tailwind.config.ts exposes income, expense, and account.{blue,violet,emerald,amber,rose,slate} colors, borderRadius xl and 2xl, and boxShadow.soft, with all pre-existing mappings intact.
app/layout.tsx metadata.title is 'Budgetku', includes appleWebApp, and exports a Viewport with viewportFit 'cover' and light/dark themeColor; Geist font and ThemeProvider unchanged.
verification: Run `npm run build` in d:\Projects\budgetku; confirm exit 0 and that /manifest.webmanifest appears in the Route table.
Run `npm run lint`; confirm no errors.
Read app/globals.css and tailwind.config.ts to confirm new tokens exist and old ones are intact.
findings:
DONE. Build exit 0; /manifest.webmanifest in Route table. Lint: only pre-existing error is tailwind.config.ts:101 `require("tailwindcss-animate")` (@typescript-eslint/no-require-imports) which existed in HEAD and is out of this feature's scope; my changes add 0 new lint errors (note: `npm run lint` runs `eslint .` with NO .next ignore, so a bare run reports ~22k errors from the gitignored .next build dir — lint source with `--ignore-pattern .next/**`).

Tailwind color classes now available (bg-/text-/border- etc.): income, income-foreground, expense, expense-foreground, and account palette account-blue, account-violet, account-emerald, account-amber, account-rose, account-slate (each with a -foreground variant). All original grayscale/shadcn tokens (background, foreground, card, popover, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring, chart-1..5) are intact in :root and .dark.

Radius: --radius raised to 0.9375rem (15px). New Tailwind radii: rounded-xl = radius+4px, rounded-2xl = radius+8px (rounded-lg/md/sm unchanged). New shadow: shadow-soft. shadcn Card still uses rounded-xl + shadow.

PWA: app/manifest.ts -> /manifest.webmanifest (name/short_name Budgetku, start_url /dashboard, display standalone, background_color #ffffff, theme_color #0a0a0a, icons icon-192.png/icon-512.png/icon-512-maskable.png under /icons/). app/layout.tsx: metadata.title 'Budgetku', appleWebApp {capable, statusBarStyle 'default', title 'Budgetku'}, and `export const viewport: Viewport` with viewportFit 'cover' + light #ffffff / dark #0a0a0a themeColor. Geist font + next-themes ThemeProvider unchanged. Icon PNGs are NOT present yet — see public/icons/README.md for required files (icon-192, icon-512, icon-512-maskable, apple-touch-icon 180x180). apple-touch-icon is auto-detected by Next from /app or /public when added.
